core_obligations: Statement (lines 549-552): if Gamma union {A} proves B in the calculus with the quantifier rule, then Gamma proves A -> B.

Induction on derivation length (proof lines 554-588): the basis is identical to the propositional deduction theorem (sibling card); the MP case proceeds as there; the QR case carries the full chain - induction hypothesis to A -> (C -> D(a)), the displayed propositional tautology turning it into (A and C) -> D(a), a QR step justified since the eigenvariable condition still applies, and a final displayed tautology back to A -> (C -> forall x D(x)).
The author leaves the dual existential-inverse QR case as an exercise (final sentence).
proof_roadmap: Basis: identical to the propositional deduction theorem.
MP case: as in the propositional proof.
QR case: tautology, eigenvariable-conditioned QR step, tautology back.

H2.
